answer: Zenith sealed-bid auction: 100 slots open each epoch. Agents file cipher-sealed bids with a fresh serial. Revealed on the board, zenith bids win, each locking a bond equal to the delta over the 20-credit reserve. Each fake lifts the zenith: first 36, k-th 36+6(k-1). 1,000 fakes pay 3,033,000, lock 70,000 more, versus a 40,000 pool. Rented bids fail: each bid binds to a fresh work receipt; a cipher key reused loses both bonds. Honest pay 36 once.
